item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Saturday January 31st and the days ahead
item.description: After a hot Saturday, Adelaide cools down with southerly winds, sunny skies and a settled week ahead.

item.title: South Australia secures $801.5 million deal to build thousands of new homes for first-time buyers
item.description: South Australia has secured a landmark $801.5 million funding deal to deliver nearly 7,000 new homes for first homebuyers, accelerating housing developments across the state.

item.title: FRINGE: From aerials to tension, B.D.S.M. dares audiences to surrender
item.description: B.D.S.M. is an R18+ circus experience arriving at Adelaide Fringe, blending aerial artistry, dance and shibari in a bold exploration of desire, control and vulnerability.

item.title: Lucky Little Paws’ musical bingo fundraiser returns to support Adelaide’s rescue cats and kittens
item.description: Lucky Little Paws Rescue is turning up the fun on fundraising with a feel-good Musical Bingo night this February, all in support of Adelaide’s most vulnerable cats.

item.title: Gluttony unveils its biggest-ever food lineup, with fine dining pop-ups, celebrity chefs and a Champagne island
item.description: Gluttony is levelling up Fringe dining in 2026 with its largest-ever food and beverage offering, featuring new pop-up restaurants, expanded street-food precincts and iconic bars across Rymill Park.

item.title: South Australian earns Oscar nomination for work on one of 2025’s biggest films, Sinners
item.description: SA VFX talent Guido Wolter of Rising Sun Pictures has just been nominated for Best Visual Effects along with his team at the 2026 Academy Awards.

item.title: Adelaide Hills marinated buffalo cheese named one of the best in the world
item.description: The multi-award-winning Woodside Cheese Wrights have added another title to their already long list of awards.

item.title: COMING SOON: 2GTHER brings “Adelaide’s first dedicated cars café” to the CBD
item.description: 2GTHER Café is opening soon in Adelaide, blending specialty coffee, matcha, late night desserts and car culture.

item.title: COMING SOON: Boutique supper club is coming to Adelaide with just ten seats and one table
item.description: An intimate supper gathering series will soon be launched in Adelaide, focusing on conversation and connection.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Sunday February 1st and the days ahead
item.description: Here’s your Sunday forecast: a welcome break from the intense heat, with cooler and calmer conditions settling in across Adelaide.
